prompt: Partner import files don't all use ISO dates: the EU feeds send `31/12/2024` or `31.12.2024` (always day first) and the US system sends `Dec 31, 2024` or `December 31, 2024`. Extend parse_date to accept those as well as ISO, ignoring surrounding whitespace. Anything else — including impossible dates like 31/02/2024 — should raise ValueError.
